theme: Where the mountains do the talking

linkedin.text:
Two hours from a warm city, there is snow on the Atlas. That contrast is the whole argument for Morocco as an incentive destination.

This is the High Atlas, from a programme we produced. Most groups arrive expecting desert and get handed a mountain range instead — and the surprise is the point. An itinerary that changes landscape twice in a week resets people far more effectively than one that keeps them in a nice hotel.

The operational reality is worth knowing before you fall in love with it. Mountain roads are slow and occasionally closed. Coach access above a certain altitude ends and you switch to 4x4s, which changes your group maths entirely. Mobile coverage is patchy, so your on-ground comms plan cannot assume a signal.

None of that is a reason to avoid it. All of it is a reason to plan it properly, which is the job.

Want an itinerary that actually changes scenery? Tell us how many days you have.
